# Produce World

> Chicago's premier international produce market. Mediterranean, Greek, Italian, Serbian, and Balkan specialty groceries. Family-owned since 1994.

## About

Produce World is a family-owned international produce market located in Norridge, IL, serving the Chicago area since 1994. We specialize in Mediterranean, Greek, Italian, Serbian, and Balkan produce and specialty items. Our motto: food is memory.

## What We Carry

- Mediterranean imports: olives, figs, pomegranates, preserved lemons, Kalamata olive oils, regional cheeses
- Balkan & Serbian favorites: ajvar, specialty peppers, dried herbs, seasonal selections
- Italian & Greek produce: heirloom tomatoes, artichokes, fresh fennel, brined grape leaves
- Locally sourced seasonal produce from Midwest farms
- Hard-to-find international ingredients sourced by request
